threads.description: The YangDataPipeline Step Functions state machine and its trigger/orchestration scaffolding. Entry: S3 ObjectCreated on opal-data-portal-v2/uploads/**manifest.json -> yang-pipeline-trigger Lambda (env STATE_MACHINE_ARN) -> StartExecution. DAG: ReadManifest(yang-validate-files) -> MoveToProcessed -> GetPriorMetadata -> GenerateLatest -> Choice(data_pkl?) -> IngestDynamoDB -> ProcessFileTypes(7 parallel branches) -> CheckNeedsPortalData -> GeneratePortalDataParallel -> GenerateManifest -> CleanupUploads -> CaptureOutputVersions -> InvalidateCloudFront -> Succeed.
producers: S3 notification yang-pipeline-manifest-trigger (opal-data-portal-v2 uploads/ + suffix manifest.json) -> yang-pipeline-trigger Lambda -> StepFunctions StartExecution
served_artifacts: CloudFront invalidation of the portal distribution
threads.frontend_resolution: Orchestration tier has no direct portal component; it sequences the generator legs and flushes CloudFront so the portal's per-tab JSON reads (via portal data proxy /api/general/**) reflect the freshly-written outputs. generate-manifest output is the freshness/version index.
threads.classification_reason: Cloud-deployed StepFn + Lambdas (S3/DDB) whose entire purpose is to produce the opal-data-portal-v2 JSON consumed by the portal; the orchestration is the spine of every consumer leg.
